item.title: Show HN: VoxHearth / small local privacy-focused STT Mac app
item.summary: I wanted to be able to use STT in the terminal for Codex / coding agents and didn't like any of the existing tools that appear to have a number of security holes so I made this one. Enjoy! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49255102 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
